abilities.name: My Sword Zaps Demons
abilities.text: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 1%  of March 7th's ATK to a single enemy and gains 1 point(s) of Charge.

abilities.name: Master, It's Tea Time!
abilities.text:
Designates a single ally (excluding this unit) as Shifu and increases Shifu's SPD by 0.1%. Only the most recent target of March 7th's Skill is considered as Shifu.
When using Basic ATK or dealing 1 hit of Enhanced Basic ATK's DMG, triggers the corresponding effect based on the specific Path of Shifu:
Erudition, Destruction, The Hunt, Remembrance: Deals Additional DMG (DMG Type based on Shifu's Combat Type) equal to 0.2% of March 7th's ATK.
Harmony, Nihility, Preservation, Abundance: Increases the Toughness Reduction of this instance of DMG by 100%.

abilities.name: March 7th, the Apex Heroine
abilities.text:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to 2.4% of March 7th's ATK to a single target enemy.
Increases the initial Hits Per Action of the next Enhanced Basic ATK by 2 hits and increase the fixed chance of additionally dealing DMG by 20%.

abilities.name: Master, I've Ascended!
abilities.text:
After Shifu uses an attack or Ultimate, March 7th gains up to 1 point of Charge each time.
Upon reaching 7 or more points of Charge, March 7th immediately takes action and increases the DMG she deals by 0.8%. Her Basic ATK gets Enhanced, and her Skill cannot be used. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, consumes 7 point(s) of Charge. Charge is capped at 10 points.

abilities.name: Feast in One Go
abilities.text:
If March 7th is on the team, she gains 1 point of Charge at the start of the next battle whenever an ally uses Technique, up to a max of 3 point(s).
After using Technique, March 7th regenerates 30 Energy when the next battle starts.

abilities.name: Swan Soar
abilities.desc: When the battle starts, March 7th's action is Advanced Forward by 25%.

abilities.name: Filigree
abilities.desc: March 7th can reduce the Toughness of enemies whose Weakness Type is the same as Shifu's Combat Type. When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.

abilities.name: Tide Tamer
abilities.desc: After using Enhanced Basic ATK, increases Shifu's CRIT DMG by 60% and Break Effect by 36%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: My Sword Stirs Starlight
abilities.desc: When Shifu is on the field, increases March 7th's SPD by 10%.

abilities.name: Blade Dances on Waves' Fight
abilities.desc: After Shifu uses Basic ATK or Skill to attack an enemy target, March 7th immediately launches a follow-up attack and deals Imaginary DMG equal to 60% of March 7th's ATK to the primary target of this attack. Additionally, triggers the corresponding effect based on Shifu's Path and then gains 1 point(s) of Charge. If there is no primary target available to attack, then attacks a single random enemy instead. This effect can only trigger once per turn.

abilities.name: Sharp Wit in Martial Might
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Being Fabulous Never Frights
abilities.desc: At the start of the turn, regenerates 5 Energy.

abilities.name: Sword Delights, Sugar Blights
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Me, the Best Girl in Sight
abilities.desc: After using Ultimate, increases the CRIT DMG dealt by the next Enhanced Basic ATK by 50%.
